result.markdown:
# Best luxury buyers’ advocates in Perth

For a prestige home in Perth, I’d prioritise a buyer’s advocate who can do more than find listings: they should have access to discreet off-market opportunities, understand the nuances of premium suburbs, independently assess a property’s true value, and negotiate on your behalf without pressure to complete a deal.

Based on my research of Perth buyer’s agencies, specialist prestige services, published credentials and available review data, **I’d start with Capital Property Advisory’s CPA Private, Lobik Advisory and Cohen Handler Perth**, then compare them with Buyers Advocate Perth for a more research-led, independent approach.

The important distinction is that a highly rated buyer’s agent is not necessarily a specialist in multimillion-dollar homes. I haven’t independently verified transaction-by-transaction results for every agency, so the shortlist below is a starting point for due diligence rather than a definitive ranking.

## My shortlist

![140 Victoria Avenue, Dalkeith, WA 6009 - Property Details](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/BT2c47tNBGdmSI0AJ7Syjc56fwhaoLAZtF-a79IQnoSb_Wam6IOkYaDJLDwR0O_c_JeFxlprbBxsQkyzu5-WV2lCn-8F5vylqZX7r3XWmJY7XYY_oJfpRSuOfg4FpJ9vyKqZYRSCcTWKjuFS2SzROeBoFEcvc5IugnWJP2g_6bJxN4kbdadONUZSWG6cMqNv?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Capital Property Advisory

(Best prestige-focused starting point)

Subiaco · CPA Private

Capital Property Advisory explicitly markets its CPA Private service to Perth prestige buyers, emphasising bespoke acquisition advice, local relationships, investment-grade due diligence and discretion. Its wider business also offers strategic property planning and portfolio advisory. [cpadvisory.com.au](https://cpadvisory.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Capital+Property+Advisory/@-31.9463351,115.8217409,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x2a32bad4dd1c158b:0x6ff752dc399ffd2d!8m2!3d-31.9463351!4d115.8217409!16s%2Fg%2F11csb0f6y7?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDkyMy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why shortlist it\:** A particularly relevant option if you want a tailored acquisition strategy rather than a conventional property search.

**Ask them\:** Which prestige homes have you acquired recently, at what price points, and how much of your sourcing is genuinely off-market?

[Website](https://cpadvisory.com.au/)

---

![Luxury property: Billionaire Andrew Budzenski sells Dalkeith mansion in Perth while Bronte film producer Mike Cordells ... - The Australian Financial Review | Architect AIA](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/3ezIgpVLXLYg-ItEHu4NQHKuJPP4lQprFXDgPMp5QsJ4FP-MTkpcuRcGTJDPA-0zKaR6hcSL266QJ5PS2D4KmNUBoem0kRCvw9zfEfi5TCMfWe7YSBav3hoan1mEtAoIbde81JqeiJpwn7RAjgfXrfEK6CuhiwjvjZjS4kA3K8n5tX1VKEfM2m99ATneSjwt?purpose=fullsize)

## 2\. Lobik Advisory - Property Buyers Agency

Claremont · Boutique western-suburbs specialist

Lobik Advisory is a boutique buyer’s agency with a stated focus on Perth’s western suburbs and nearby prestige markets. Its approach considers both long-term value and lifestyle suitability, including building quality, orientation, functionality and future adaptability. [cpadvisory.com.au](https://cpadvisory.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Capital+Property+Advisory/@-31.9463351,115.8217409,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x2a32bad4dd1c158b:0x6ff752dc399ffd2d!8m2!3d-31.9463351!4d115.8217409!16s%2Fg%2F11csb0f6y7?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDkyMy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJB1HR6PSlMioRg8mK6kydAPE&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why shortlist it\:** A strong candidate to interview if your brief centres on established western-suburbs homes, architect-designed residences or a property where the details matter as much as the address.

**Ask them\:** Which suburbs and price brackets do you work in most often, and can you demonstrate recent comparable acquisitions?

Unit 2/414 Stirling Highway, Claremont

## 3\. Cohen Handler Buyers Agents Perth

Nedlands · National buyer-advocacy network

Cohen Handler has a national buyer-advocacy operation and a Perth office in Nedlands. Its Perth service covers residential acquisition, and its published material includes guidance on prestige locations such as Perth’s western-suburbs “Golden Triangle.” [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Cohen+Handler+Buyers+Agents+Perth/@-31.980462,115.7972263,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x2a32a5aaf61a8c9b:0x477570eb49a8a61c!8m2!3d-31.980462!4d115.7972263!16s%2Fg%2F11z0yzbgq8?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDkyMy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[whichrealestateagent.com.au](https://whichrealestateagent.com.au/buyers-agent/best-buyers-agents-in-perth/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why shortlist it\:** Worth considering if you want a broader agent network, support for interstate or international purchasing, and access to opportunities beyond public listings.

**Ask them\:** Who personally handles your search, how many comparable prestige acquisitions have they completed in Perth, and what evidence can they provide of off-market access?

[Website](https://cohenhandler.com.au/)

---

![69 Beatrice Road, Dalkeith, WA 6009 for Sale | view.com.au](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/oo95-_QXFfY7nZPLtIke_OqSYLYgN05bLuUGq09ir1FdNG0O3HzmX0dZ3anImzn11vXTJwZXx1Nx3iwe1HDrfC3Ue-GMzHjXxmP4te_eRB1wxVWmGkHMxZ0uSWuRu9Z-tEt_CRLOb7IiWRJSxyBUiWL_dZ2hgRWQDn3pEWEwfBCKjV_d2J7tCNW_hRmjfGF8?purpose=fullsize)

## 4\. Buyers Advocate Perth

West Perth · Independent buyer representation

Led by Ray Chua and Lisa Do, Buyers Advocate Perth focuses on residential property research, careful selection, negotiation and long-term value. REIWA’s profile reports that Chua has worked exclusively on the buyer’s side since 2008 and has helped purchase almost 600 homes and investment properties. [reiwa.com.au](https://reiwa.com.au/real-estate-agent/ray-chua-160583-0-64574/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[reiwa.com.au](https://reiwa.com.au/real-estate-agency/buyers-advocate-perth-160583-0/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why shortlist it\:** A useful benchmark for disciplined, independent advice, particularly if you want an advocate willing to reject unsuitable properties rather than simply secure a purchase.

**Caveat\:** Confirm that your particular price bracket and prestige segment are a regular part of their current workload.

[Website](https://www.buyersadvocateperth.com.au/)

---

![Nemo Home Premium | Luxury Custom Home Builder & Renovation Specialist Perth, WA](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/vVSu3Kt6lVuhKp188efb0qFMgg_Q_cwZtkow4u2_7GiiWDBZKtvnY1Asaw-BXERJ0Njy8dJw0uhJ6rIPJVMSMUW4QpW8qzMv1zbhF7xrpr3sLQgXTgAd2WA75ScPR5BIfuQKho9EOtJJQ6aNkcl29Dl2dZOTinGYPYRqjOdP1IaAVKGMbRLEbRbZOSkbGtVq?purpose=fullsize)

## 5\. Resolve Property Solutions - Buyer's Agent Perth

South Perth · Boutique independent agency

Resolve Property Solutions offers buyer-side search, property assessment, negotiation and due diligence across metropolitan Perth. Its public business listing shows a 5.0 rating from approximately 275 reviews at the time of research. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJKYSD2Ly7MioRS7M4vd_9rto&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[propertygo.com.au](https://propertygo.com.au/buyer-agents/in/perth?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why shortlist it\:** A worthwhile comparison for service quality, local agent relationships and execution.

**Caveat\:** Its strong overall review profile is not, by itself, proof of experience acquiring trophy homes or ultra-high-value residences.

[Website](https://resolvepropertysolutions.com.au/)

## Two additional specialists worth considering

![38 Marine Parade, Cottesloe WA 6011 - property.com.au](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gBJ4kgaoG_4moQz65P0dTfwYNIWNEOqdKqjEjfQRvYos3UF4NJ_D9HM1LomUjIWFTb0zxhKFNuWV3g5Qk-6oz9JzQdrm_7hqIk7uf6zx6rt5SZJto_SJLyyaVu6mXZYVxoFLFaskBZjawcLXDFmV0FlE5pIAeyYhorRzsldVVFH8b09OgPgjh3MCRKW9nROt?purpose=fullsize)

**Verve Buyers Agency**

A particularly relevant candidate for Dalkeith and surrounding prestige streets. Its published suburb service describes regular local inspections, selling-agent relationships and valuation-led negotiation in a market where comparable sales can be scarce. [vervebuyersagency.com](https://vervebuyersagency.com/suburbs/dalkeith/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Visit Verve Buyers Agency](https://vervebuyersagency.com/)

---

![Dalkeith home named the nation's best](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9oBcXT87NidWcq5QuJZvKRZjkaV0kcceDzUTcEsRYzDs5zxsNE4MTX3O8LgIDCnWnHJ9IC4twuIhiZL12AvPg7mBQKCaPleWjNyJRGTIFeoN28xfGNZT2XBnnrPg17kO7xiCSFv3QQlVVR7S1feZVb-URzp3yenb8jGCEFRl1BGUKZr8yRSoS_4bpj-tg6Dy?purpose=fullsize)

**Pentony Buyers Agent Perth**

Led by Jude Pentony, the business explicitly advertises bespoke luxury and executive buying, including discreet sourcing in Cottesloe, Dalkeith and Peppermint Grove. I would ask for verified examples of comparable acquisitions before appointing them. [jpentony.com.au](https://jpentony.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id%3AChIJUUc5Lc6_MioRUzl3cbJX_Dk&hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Visit Pentony Buyers Agent](https://jpentony.com.au/)

## Where the best advocates should be strongest

These are the areas I would prioritise when evaluating a prestige-home acquisition specialist.



- **Dalkeith and Peppermint Grove\:** riverfront estates, large landholdings, privacy and scarce comparable sales.
- **Cottesloe and Swanbourne\:** premium coastal homes, architectural quality and proximity to the beach.
- **City Beach\:** contemporary luxury homes, larger family residences and coastal lifestyle properties.
- **Nedlands and Claremont\:** established homes, family lifestyle requirements and access to sought-after school areas.

These are established prestige markets, but the right advocate depends on your specific brief and price range. [www.buyersagents.com.au](https://www.buyersagents.com.au/buyers-agents/perth/western-suburbs?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[cohenhandler.com.au](https://cohenhandler.com.au/the-pinnacle-of-perth-an-insiders-guide-to-western-australias-golden-triangle/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[resolvepropertysolutions.com.au](https://resolvepropertysolutions.com.au/areas-we-service/western-suburbs/dalkeith/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## How I would select the winner

Before signing an engagement agreement, I would interview three agencies and ask each the same questions.

| What to test | What a strong answer looks like |
|--------|--------|
| Prestige track record | Recent completed acquisitions in your price bracket, with references where permitted |
| Off-market access | Specific examples of properties sourced privately, not just claims of a large network |
| Valuation discipline | Comparable settled sales, adjustments for land, condition and location, and a defensible maximum price |
| Due diligence | Independent building and pest inspections, title and planning checks, and specialist advice where needed |
| Negotiation | A clear offer strategy, walk-away price and explanation of how the agent is remunerated |
| Discretion | Confidential handling of your identity, finances, brief and communications |
| Independence | Clear disclosure of commissions, referral fees and any relationships with selling agents or developers |


One particularly important question is whether the senior advocate you meet will personally manage your acquisition, or whether it will be handed to another team member.

**My recommendation\:** Start with CPA Private for a dedicated luxury acquisition service, compare it against Lobik Advisory for western-suburbs expertise and Cohen Handler for its network and established buyer-advocacy operation. Include Verve if Dalkeith is a primary target.

The right shortlist changes considerably depending on the value and type of home you intend to buy.

search_results.title: Ray White TMG Luxury launches amid Gold Coast market downturn
search_results.description: Ray White TMG Luxury has launched amid a downturn in the Gold Coast property market, marked by four interest rate hikes, Middle East conflict, and changes to federal property tax policies. Ray White chief economist Nerida Conisbee remarked on the market’s uncertainty, though noting it is currently easier to transact. The launch featured a premium Broadbeach Waters property at 29 Namatjira Court with 95m of river frontage, 533 sq m of luxury living space, and high-end amenities such as a cocktail lounge and riverside pool. Despite a 3% decline in overall Gold Coast property values over the past year, the luxury segment in Broadbeach Waters remains resilient, mirroring stabilizing trends in Sydney’s Eastern suburbs and Melbourne’s South Yarra and Toorak. The event also marked the official unveiling of Ray White TMG Luxury, a new prestige-focused division led by CEO Matt Micallef. Micallef emphasized the division’s goal to provide a specialist approach for high-end buyers and sellers, asserting the Gold Coast's legitimacy as a top-tier luxury market. The luxury brand aims to respond to growing demand with dedicated, high-caliber service.

- **Dalkeith and Peppermint Grove\:** riverfront estates, large landholdings, privacy and scarce comparable sales.
- **Cottesloe and Swanbourne\:** premium coastal homes, architectural quality and proximity to the beach.
- **City Beach\:** contemporary luxury homes, larger family residences and coastal lifestyle properties.
- **Nedlands and Claremont\:** established homes, family lifestyle requirements and access to sought-after school areas.

These are established prestige markets, but the right advocate depends on your specific brief and price range. ## How I would select the winner

Before signing an engagement agreement, I would interview three agencies and ask each the same questions.

sources.title: Buyers Agents in Western Suburbs Perth
The Pinnacle of Perth: An Insider’s Guide to Western Australia’s Golden Triangle

items.markdown:
| What to test | What a strong answer looks like |
|--------|--------|
| Prestige track record | Recent completed acquisitions in your price bracket, with references where permitted |
| Off-market access | Specific examples of properties sourced privately, not just claims of a large network |
| Valuation discipline | Comparable settled sales, adjustments for land, condition and location, and a defensible maximum price |
| Due diligence | Independent building and pest inspections, title and planning checks, and specialist advice where needed |
| Negotiation | A clear offer strategy, walk-away price and explanation of how the agent is remunerated |
| Discretion | Confidential handling of your identity, finances, brief and communications |
| Independence | Clear disclosure of commissions, referral fees and any relationships with selling agents or developers |

One particularly important question is whether the senior advocate you meet will personally manage your acquisition, or whether it will be handed to another team member.

**My recommendation\:** Start with CPA Private for a dedicated luxury acquisition service, compare it against Lobik Advisory for western-suburbs expertise and Cohen Handler for its network and established buyer-advocacy operation. Include Verve if Dalkeith is a primary target.
